question: Nice to meet you! I tried doing something interesting that I'd like to see go into SBS! *laughs* I tabulated how much of the art in Usopp's Gallery Pirate Crew has come from each prefecture!! Here are the top five: 1. Tokyo (219 times), 2. Osaka (143 times), 3. Kanagawa (142 times), 4. Saitama (139 times), 5. Chiba (120 times) Tokyo is really something, huh!! It was really a pain counting them all!
answer: Wow- thanks and good work!! But wait wait what!? The number of exclamation marks... the number of postcards... has counting things suddenly come into fashion!?
